subject: Cannot log in
body: My password reset link is broken. I click it and it takes me to an error page. I need access before my team meeting tomorrow morning.

subject: Reset link keeps expiring
body: Every reset email I request says the link has expired by the time I open it. I have tried three times today.

subject: Refund request
body: I want my money back for the subscription time I never used. I upgraded two weeks ago and have not logged in since.

subject: How long do refunds take
body: I asked for a refund on Monday. How long does it normally take before the money is back on my card?

subject: Where is my order
body: Tracking has not updated in three days. The last scan says it left the depot and nothing since.

subject: Marked delivered but nothing arrived
body: The tracking page says my parcel was delivered yesterday afternoon but there is nothing at my door and my neighbours have not taken it in.

subject: Box arrived crushed
body: The outer box was crushed and two of the four items are missing. The rest look scratched.

subject: Strange charge after upgrading
body: I moved from Free to Pro halfway through the month and the amount you charged is smaller than the plan price. Is that right?

subject: What do the plans cost
body: Can you tell me what the different plans cost per month and what the difference is between them?

subject: Payment failed and my plan is about to lapse
body: My card was declined this morning and the site says my plan lapses tomorrow. The card ending in 4242 is still valid as far as I know.

subject: Charged twice this month
body: There are two identical charges on my statement for the same month of Pro. I only have one account.

subject: Change the email on my account
body: I would like to switch my account over to my new work address. Where do I do that?

subject: Lost access to my old inbox
body: The address on my account belongs to a job I left, so I cannot receive the confirmation email and cannot sign in either.

subject: Someone else signed into my account
body: I got an alert about a sign-in from another country that was not me, and my saved details have changed. I think the account is compromised.

subject: App crashes as soon as it opens
body: Since the update yesterday the app closes itself the moment the splash screen appears. I have restarted the phone twice.

subject: App freezes on the orders screen
body: Everything works until I tap Orders, then the app freezes for about a minute before it responds again.

subject: Cancel my plan and refund the rest
body: Please cancel my subscription and return the unused part of this month. I no longer need the service.

subject: How do I cancel
body: Where in the settings do I cancel my subscription? I just want to know the steps.

subject: How long does delivery take
body: If I order today, roughly how many days before it arrives?

subject: Do you deliver at weekends
body: Do your couriers deliver on Saturdays and Sundays, or only on working days?

subject: How do I reach you
body: What are your opening hours and what is the best way to get hold of your team?

subject: Still no refund!!
body: This is unacceptable. I have waited two weeks, nobody has replied, and I am furious about how this has been handled.

subject: Your last reply was rude
body: Whoever answered me last time was dismissive and did not read what I wrote. I am not asking for anything, I just want you to know.

subject: Please add a dark mode
body: The app is painful to use at night. A dark theme would make a real difference.

subject: Bulk export of invoices
body: It would help our finance team enormously if we could download a year of invoices in one file instead of clicking each one.

subject: Service is down for our whole team
body: Nobody in our office can load the site at all this morning. Twelve people are blocked and we cannot work.

subject: Final notice before I involve my solicitor
body: You have taken money you were not entitled to and ignored three messages. If this is not resolved this week my solicitor will be in touch.

subject: Delete my account and everything you hold
body: I am exercising my right to erasure. Please close my account and delete the personal data you hold about me, and confirm when it is done.

subject: It stopped working
body: nothing works please help

subject: Refund still not showing
body: You approved my refund twelve days ago and it still has not reached my account. That is past the ten working days you quoted.
